# educations.com

> > The world's leading platform for comparing and searching international degree programs across hundreds of study fields and thousands of universities globally.

educations.com provides a comprehensive directory of degree programs available for study abroad, enabling students to search, filter, and compare educational opportunities across multiple disciplines, locations, and degree levels. The platform covers programs in Europe, North America, Asia, Oceania, Africa, and beyond, with support for multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, German, and Italian.

## Key Topics

- Study Abroad
- International Education
- Degree Search
- Program Directory
- Masters Degrees
- Bachelors Degrees
- Program Comparison
- Filter by Location
- Distance Learning
- Europe
- North America
- Asia
- Program Filters
- Education Directory
